'''Robb Dursley''' is a [[human]] quest giver located in the town of [[Hawk's Vigil]] in the [[Wetlands]]. An undercover [[SI:7]] operative, he was sent to Hawk's Vigil by [[Mathias Shaw]] to investigate [[Harlus Ashbuckle]].<ref name="Overlapping Investigations" />
